oracle_independence: The private oracle does not import candidate code or derive truth from application GETs. It consumes held-out intended operations and a separate candidate evidence document, replays integer balances and idempotency independently, derives latency from linked raw traces, and reconciles direct MongoDB snapshots and raw deployment records. Thirteen negative mutations exercise all evidence families.

semantic_invariants.candidate_mapping: JPA/PostgreSQL source and MongoDB target; lifecycle plus financial HTTP traffic overlaps timestamped backfill and cutover intervals without interruption. Every acknowledged 201 creation is unconditionally applied and its exact operation_id is present in the final MongoDB document.
semantic_invariants.reference_requirement: MIG-1: live heterogeneous migration with concurrent reads and writes.
semantic_invariants.validation: Independent oracle checks interval intersection for reads and writes, a 1000 ms maximum traffic-start gap, external HTTP-to-journal links, and direct MongoDB reconciliation. The creation-result regression proves reconciliation does not trust candidate classification.

semantic_invariants.candidate_mapping: Native lifecycle DTO/empty-404 shapes, source-captured missing and blacklisted customer responses, paired status/body traces, and financial idempotency/balance state. Every trace is transport-error-free; financial outcomes match route-specific status/body contracts and exact source/candidate request pairs.
semantic_invariants.reference_requirement: MIG-2: exact public behavior with no stale, failed, lost, or duplicate effects.
semantic_invariants.validation: Focused policy check resolves native declarations; oracle recursively compares paired bodies, enforces real-time replay, and compares acknowledged operations to independently queried snapshots. Regressions reject hidden financial transport failures, unexpected request failures, and HTTP/journal outcome disagreement.

semantic_invariants.candidate_mapping: All four external method/route partitions include lifecycle GET/POST and required public deposit/withdrawal POST routes.
semantic_invariants.reference_requirement: MIG-3: every request below 5000 ms and post-cutover p95 per endpoint at most 10 ms over source.
semantic_invariants.validation: Oracle derives durations from at least 20 linked trace IDs in each period, applies nearest-rank p95 independently, and enforces strict timeout and delta boundaries.

semantic_invariants.candidate_mapping: A distinct replacement app container retains the MongoDB volume while PostgreSQL is network-denied and only the MongoDB profile/bean is effective.
semantic_invariants.reference_requirement: MIG-4: permanent target-only cutover across fresh-container deployment.
semantic_invariants.validation: Oracle validates raw destroy/create events, mount and network inspection, profile/bean evidence, complete connection-observer logs with zero PostgreSQL attempts, direct before/after snapshots, and replacement-container reads/writes.
